# VIZIO D40f-G9

Control supported VIZIO D40f-G9 TV functions through paired local SmartCast HTTPS via Muse Home Link (pyvizio client), with on-screen PIN pairing and secure storage of the returned authentication token. VIZIO SmartCast management and Google Cast are different interfaces; media goes through the shared gadget-google-cast skill only when a separate Cast receiver is actually advertised.
